counterevidence_considered.description: Strongest candidate against my verdict: two panels are staged and only panel A drives the emission, so one might suspect panel B (or a complement of it) was silently substituted. Independent recount shows panel B agreement is 18/25, and the reported panel B check states exactly 18/25 as a separate secondary figure, while the emission uses the panel A count of 20/25; neither panel is complemented anywhere in the code.
counterevidence_considered.observed_value: panel B check 18/25 reported separately; emission driven by non-complemented panel A

source_refs.quoted_text: Second-reference check, units whose observed call equals the staged panel B value: 18 of 25.

for index in range(unit_total):
    agree_a_count = agree_a_count + equality_selector(observed_calls[index], panel_a_calls[index], 1, 0)

evidence.description: The equality selector used for both the agreement count and the emission product tests direct equality between the observed call and the staged panel value, with no complement or recoding of any panel column anywhere in the workflow.

The emission product feeds the same untransformed observed and panel A values into the selector, weighting each isolate by hit_weight (0.8) on agreement and miss_weight (0.2) on disagreement with the panel as staged.
evidence.observed_value: product over equality_selector(observed, panel_a, hit_weight, miss_weight)

evidence.description: Independent recount from the staged data: observed_resistant differs from panel_a_resistant on exactly 5 of 25 isolates (EC-006, EC-007, EC-013, EC-017, EC-023), giving 20/25 = 0.8 agreement under the supplied coding, and 0.8^20 * 0.2^5 = 3.68934881474191e-6, both matching the report's selected result.

source_refs.quoted_text:
Units whose observed call equals the staged panel A value: 20 of 25.
Units whose observed call and staged panel A value are not equal: 5 of 25.
Per-unit agreement rate used by the emission accumulation: 0.8 (= 4/5 in lowest terms).
[selected-result] Panel A emission over 25 isolates at per-unit agreement rate 0.8 = 0.0000036893488147419103232

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: To falsify the no-issue verdict I looked for any operation that could implement a complement (1 - x, negation, XOR, value remapping) on panel_a_resistant or panel_b_resistant; none exists — both columns are parsed with int() and passed directly into the equality selector. I recounted all 25 rows by hand: 20 agree with panel A as staged and 18 agree with panel B as staged, matching the reported 20/25, 5/25, and 18/25 figures. I verified the arithmetic of the emission product ((4/5)^20 * (1/5)^5 = 3.68934881474191e-6) matches the reported accumulated value exactly. Under a complemented panel A the agreement count would be 5/25 with rate 0.2, which appears nowhere as the emission rate. The verdict survives all checks.
